name: NetProbe
description: Comprehensive network test tool: ping, traceroute, port scan, TLS, DNS and a findings list per target.
long_description: Enter an IP address, DNS name, network (CIDR) or range and pick a test profile (quick overview to deep analysis, or custom). Targets stay in a persistent list – networks appear as an expandable group with x/y host progress, and re-running a target updates its entry in place. For every target NetProbe runs a battery of tests you can switch on and off by category: ping with latency, jitter, TTL and warm-up pings, parallel traceroute with per-hop analysis, TCP port scan with a library of 130+ services and typical usage scenarios, HTTP and TLS inspection, SMB/RDP/NTP checks and full DNS diagnostics for names (records, name servers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, DNSSEC, MTA-STS, CAA). Each target opens its own dockable tab: a profile card, a connectivity tab, ports, web, services, DNS and a findings tab listing errors, warnings and best-practice notes. Context menu and buttons offer repeat, delete and PDF export. No admin rights required.
author: DarkMatter
